info.description: Complete API collection for AI Suggestion Service - Study Plans and Student Analytics

item.name: Student Analytics

query.description: LTI user identifier (contains 'new' to get new student data)

request.description: Returns analytics data for a new student with minimal progress
Returns analytics data for an active student with progress, assignments, and recommendations

item.description: Student analytics endpoints for tracking student progress and recommendations

item.name: Study Plan Management

request.description: Creates a new study plan with course outline and weekly tasks
Retrieves a study plan by its unique ID

item.name: Get Study Plan by Thread ID

request.description: Retrieves a study plan by thread ID (conversation tracking)
Updates an existing study plan based on courseKey and userKey
Updates the status of a specific week in a study plan. Valid status values: NOT_STARTED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED
Marks a specific week as in progress

item.description: Study plan management endpoints for creating and tracking student learning plans
